queries.sql: SELECT r.* FROM public.pay_payroll_runs r WHERE r.tenant_id=:trustedTenant AND r.public_id=:pathRunId FOR UPDATE
SELECT s.* FROM public.pay_input_snapshots s WHERE s.tenant_id=:trustedTenant AND s.input_snapshot_id=:run.input_snapshot_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT v.* FROM public.pay_input_source_vectors v WHERE v.tenant_id=:trustedTenant AND v.input_snapshot_id=:snapshot.input_snapshot_id ORDER BY v.source_kind,v.contract_ref,v.owner_object_public_id,v.owner_revision
SELECT i.* FROM public.pay_input_source_ingest_receipts i WHERE i.tenant_id=:trustedTenant AND i.public_id=:vector.ingest_receipt_public_id AND i.input_snapshot_id=:snapshot.input_snapshot_id
SELECT p.* FROM public.pay_owner_snapshot_payloads p WHERE p.tenant_id=:trustedTenant AND p.ingest_receipt_id=:ingest.input_source_ingest_receipt_id
SELECT a.* FROM public.pay_payroll_run_attempts a WHERE a.tenant_id=:trustedTenant AND a.payroll_run_id=:run.payroll_run_id AND a.attempt_no=:run.latest_attempt_no
SELECT m.* FROM public.pay_result_staging_manifests m WHERE m.tenant_id=:trustedTenant AND m.attempt_id=:attempt.payroll_run_attempt_id

SELECT w.* FROM public.pay_worker_results w WHERE w.tenant_id=:trustedTenant AND w.payroll_run_attempt_id=:attempt.payroll_run_attempt_id ORDER BY w.worker_public_id,w.assignment_public_id,w.currency_code
SELECT l.* FROM public.pay_result_lines l WHERE l.tenant_id=:trustedTenant AND l.worker_result_public_id=:result.public_id ORDER BY l.element_public_id,l.public_id
SELECT v.* FROM public.pay_run_validation_reports v WHERE v.tenant_id=:trustedTenant AND v.payroll_run_id=:run.payroll_run_id AND v.attempt_id=:attempt.payroll_run_attempt_id
SELECT b.* FROM public.pay_run_approval_bindings b WHERE b.tenant_id=:trustedTenant AND b.public_id=:bodyApprovalBindingId AND b.subject_public_id=:run.public_id
SELECT f.* FROM public.pay_run_finalization_receipts f WHERE f.tenant_id=:trustedTenant AND f.payroll_run_id=:run.payroll_run_id
